description: This source file defines the `ChatMarkdownPreprocessor` enum that provides static methods for preprocessing markdown chat messages. It performs tasks such as stripping envelope headers, message ID hints, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and extracting inline images from markdown content. The class also contains utility methods for identifying and handling specific markdown patterns, untrusted context blocks, and encoding images.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.Result
classes.description: A struct representing the result of markdown preprocessing, containing the cleaned markdown string and an array of inline images.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.InlineImage
classes.description: A struct representing an inline image extracted from markdown, including label and image data.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main entry point that takes raw markdown string and returns a Result with cleaned text and images after processing.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Creates an InlineImage if the source string is a base64-encoded image data URI.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel
methods.description: Provides a fallback label for images when the label is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw input if they match the expected pattern.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header string matches known envelope header formats or channels.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes message ID hint lines from the raw input.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks
methods.description: Removes inbound context blocks, including fenced JSON blocks, from the raw input.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext
methods.description: Determines whether to strip trailing untrusted context based on specific patterns.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from lines in the raw input.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace and line endings in the raw input.
